rationale: Lydia brings deep expertise in developer experience and LLM tooling from her work at Anthropic's Claude Code team, while Sharon is building production-ready AI agent infrastructure at TheAgentic.Ai — creating a natural fit for exploring how great DX can unlock adoption of agentic AI systems. Lydia's track record translating complex technical concepts into accessible tooling (JavaScript ecosystem at Vercel/Bun, Claude Code at Anthropic) could offer valuable perspective on how to communicate and build developer-friendly interfaces for the agent infrastructure Sharon's team is shipping.
intro_message: Lydia Hallie, meet Sharon — you're both working at the intersection of developer tooling and AI systems, and Lydia's experience scaling DX at Claude Code and Vercel could be valuable as you think about how developers will actually use production AI agent infrastructure.
